definitions.gloss: dressing warmly; wearing thick layers of clothing
definitions.explanation: Wearing multiple or thick layers of clothing to stay warm, typically in cold weather. The opposite is {薄着|うすぎ} (dressing lightly).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚着|あつぎ}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{出|で}かけよう→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。
examples.english: Let's dress warmly before heading out today.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{厚着|あつぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させ→する：00392_suru⟧すぎる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{汗|あせ}をかく→汗をかく：16925_asewokaku⟧。
examples.english: If you overdress children in heavy clothing, they'll sweat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{厚着|あつぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦していて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{寒|さむ}く→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even when dressed warmly, you can still feel cold during winter in Hokkaido.

notes:
USAGE:
{厚着|あつぎ} is a compound of ⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ (thick) and {着|ぎ} (wearing). Used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ as a suru-verb: {厚着|あつぎ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to dress warmly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厚着|あつぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to dress warmly)
- {厚着|あつぎ}しすぎる (to overdress)
- {厚着|あつぎ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦させる→する：00392_suru⟧ (to dress someone warmly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {厚着|あつぎ}: dressing warmly, wearing heavy layers
- ⟦{薄着|うすぎ}→薄着：14028_usugi⟧: dressing lightly (antonym)
- ⟦{重|かさ}ね{着|ぎ}→重ね着：26975_kasanegi⟧: layering, wearing layered clothing
